cases.reason: Format and SR9 are word-identical, and SR9 leans on 'the prime record key for that file'. That key is what the RECORD KEY clause declares, and its syntax rules differ: 2002 SR1 says only that data-name-1 'may be qualified', while 2023 SR1 says it 'shall not be subject to any OCCURS clauses'. If 2002 admits a subscripted RECORD KEY (data-name includes 'subscription if needed' in the 2002 metalanguage table, and 8.4.1.2.2 SR5 requires a table element reference to be subscripted), SR9 then requires the first sort key to sit at the byte location of a table element such as IX-K(2), a case the 2023 verdict cannot see. Probe sort9-occkey.cob (SD key at offset 3, GIVING an indexed file with RECORD KEY IX-K(2)) is refused at --std 2002 with COBOL2024 on the RECORD KEY, so the 2002 SORT case cannot even be compiled. Settled by the adjudication of the subscripted-RECORD-KEY question (p-01 refute overturned 12.3.4.12 GR3/GR4 on it): if 2002 permits it, OVERTURNED; if not, UPHELD.

cases.reason: The answerer enumerated 2002 class national as 'national, national-edited, numeric-edited usage national, national group items' and said the 2002 table equals 2023's; but 2002's national category (§2002:8.5.2.7 item 3) also lists 'An elementary data item explicitly or implicitly described as usage national', which 2023 §2023:8.5.2.10 (and 2014) dropped. Read literally, PIC 9(n) USAGE NATIONAL and PIC 1(n) USAGE NATIONAL are category, hence class, national in 2002, a datum the 2023 evidence never shows. Other 2002 text (§2002:13.16.22.3 GR4 'class numeric with usage national', §2002:14.8.23.3 GR2a) contradicts that reading, so it is not decisive either way; the flag answer did not address it. For THIS rule the reading flips the outcome: STRING N"AB" NN INTO NT (NN PIC 9(3) USAGE NATIONAL, NT PIC N(10)) is legal at 2002 if NN is class national, but the compiler refuses it COBOL2306 at 2002 (as at 2023); STRING "AB" NN INTO XT (alphanumeric receiver) is illegal if NN is class national, and the compiler accepts and runs it at 2002 (AB123). Settle with one ruling (a docs/conformance entry or kb/Work decision): whether §2002:8.5.2.7 item 3, absent from 2014 and 2023, is inoperative for an elementary item whose PICTURE gives category numeric, numeric-edited or boolean (as §2002:13.16.22.3 GR4, §2002:14.8.23.3 GR2a and Table 3 presuppose), or makes such an item (also) category and class national at --std 2002. If inoperative: UPHELD. If operative: DIFFERENT, compiler-at-2002 wrong.
